Please Consider the Situation of Ukrainian Dota 2 Players
6 hours ago
[ФР] Дикограй
For Ukrainian players, maintaining a high Behavior Score and Communication Score during the war can be extremely difficult. We face missile and drone attacks, emergency power outages, and unstable internet connections.
This makes it difficult to avoid toxic interactions and repeated reports from players who may target us because of our nationality.

We are not asking to be exempt from punishment when we genuinely break the rules. We are asking Valve to consider the reality Ukrainian players face and introduce a fairer, more individual approach to reviewing reports and disconnects caused by emergencies.
